edges.reason: msg.sender is written into shopManager during construction, granting the privileged role to the deployer
withdraw authorization depends on msg.sender equalling shopManager and sends funds to msg.sender
setShopManager authorization and the new manager address derive from the caller context
setToken is gated by the onlyShopManager modifier that compares msg.sender
msg.sender is both the payment source and the NFT recipient in purchaseProduct
chizToken.transferFrom pulls payment directly from msg.sender, a caller controlled account
tokenContract.transferFrom delivers the NFT to msg.sender, enabling receiver side callbacks
withdraw performs the external ERC20 transfer of withdrawAmount
purchaseProduct invokes ERC20 transferFrom for the product price
purchaseProduct invokes ERC721 transferFrom to deliver the token
purchaseProduct queries ownership through external ERC721 calls
createProduct validates ownership using external ERC721 ownerOf and balanceOf calls
The external token transfer in withdraw hands control to the token contract before state settles
Calling transferFrom on an arbitrary ERC20 address can reenter purchaseProduct before the mapping is rewritten
ERC721 transfer outbound call can reenter purchaseProduct prior to the final Products write
Receiving an NFT can trigger the recipient contract onERC721Received hook
